## 🎙 Guest Primer: *The Aesthetic Edge* ft. Peel Haus Aesthetics & Plastic Surgery

**Podcast Title (Working Draft):**  
**“Power, Precision & Peel Haus: Redefining Aesthetics on Pennsylvania Avenue”**

**Host:** Bethany Gifford  
**Podcast:** *The Aesthetic Edge*

---

### 💡 About the Episode  
This episode of *The Aesthetic Edge* features a powerhouse trio: **Sorelle Cooper, FNP-BC**, **Wendy Pittman**, and **Sonya Lowery-Young, LE**—the visionary founders behind **Peel Haus Aesthetics & Plastic Surgery**, the first medical aesthetic and plastic surgery center located on Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington, D.C.

Together, they’ve built more than just a practice—they’ve redefined what aesthetic care looks like in one of the country’s most influential corridors. From pioneering inclusive skincare protocols to curating a team committed to natural, high-standard results, Peel Haus is a movement as much as it is a medspa.

---

### 🗓 Interview Overview  
The podcast is a **40-60 minute conversation**, edited down to a highly produced **20-minute episode**.  

We’ll cover topics such as:  
- The founding story of Peel Haus and your roles within it  
- Your vision for combining clinical excellence with inclusive care  
- How your Capitol Hill location uniquely shapes your practice  
- Innovations like GloTox and treating skin of color with intention  
- Challenges faced—and solutions you've created—within the industry  
- Leadership, retention, and redefining the patient experience  
- The importance of trust, transparency, and diversity in modern aesthetics  

---

### 🎧 What to Expect  
- **Format**: Conversational, relaxed but insightful  
- **Length**: 40-60 minutes (edited to 20 min)  
- **Software**: [Riverside.fm](https://riverside.fm) (Join via Chrome browser, quiet space, strong Wi-Fi recommended)  
- **Prep**: Please join 5–10 minutes early for sound/video check  
- **Style**: Engaging, human, educational—we're spotlighting YOU as industry disruptors  

---

### 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Featured Guests

#### **Sorelle Cooper, FNP-BC** – *President & CEO*  
Board-certified Nurse Practitioner with 19+ years in healthcare and a passion for transformative aesthetic medicine. Known for natural-looking results, advanced injection techniques, and international consulting work in dermatology, including partnerships in West Africa.

#### **Wendy Pittman** – *Vice President of Business Development*  
An industry veteran with over 25 years of impact, Wendy helped launch BOTOX® Cosmetic and spearheaded the Brown Skin Agenda. She brings unmatched experience in business growth, market strategy, and patient-centric innovation.

#### **Sonya Lowery-Young, LE** – *Chief Brand Officer*  
A multi-licensed medical esthetician focused on treating skin of color and aging concerns. Sonya is the architect behind many Peel Haus signature services and has earned national recognition for her inclusive, clinical-forward approach.

---

### 🧭 About Peel Haus Aesthetics & Plastic Surgery  
Located in a historic building on **Pennsylvania Avenue**, Peel Haus is the first of its kind in D.C.—offering premium medical-grade skincare, injectables, and cosmetic surgery under one roof. Founded by three D.C. natives, the practice celebrates community, clinical excellence, and natural beauty across all skin tones and identities.

#### Core Values:  
- **Excellence** – Uncompromising training, safety, and results  
- **Inclusion** – Truly serving *all* skin tones, backgrounds, and identities  
- **Transparency** – Honest, collaborative care rooted in trust

---

### 🔗 Resources & Next Steps  
- **Recording Link**: (Will be sent upon scheduling)  
- **Prep Notes**: Quiet space, Chrome browser, headphones optional  
- **Contacts**:  
   - Wendy Pittman – wendy@peelhaus.com  
   - Sorelle Cooper – sorel@peelhaus.com  
   - Sonya Lowery – sonia@peelhaus.com  
   - Georgina (Operations) – georgina@peelhaus.com

---

### 📌 Scheduling  
Please coordinate internally and send 2–3 preferred time slots for a 60-minute recording. Once confirmed, we’ll send the Riverside link and a calendar invite.

Bethany Gifford is a 10-year dermatology veteran turned agency founder, returning to the aesthetic world to document and spotlight the most forward-thinking professionals shaping the future of skin health and beauty. *The Aesthetic Edge* is designed to bring real insight, innovation, and strategy to the forefront of the aesthetic medicine conversation.

With over 15 episodes recorded and industry leaders like Dr. Ashkan Ghavami, Chino Bay, and Melissa Halusum on the radar, this podcast is built to make an impact—for practitioners and patients alike.

### 🎯 Why This Matters  

**Bethany Gifford** is a 10-year dermatology veteran turned agency founder, returning to the aesthetic industry with a mission: to document and spotlight the most forward-thinking professionals shaping the future of skin health and beauty. *The Aesthetic Edge* podcast is built to go deeper than surface-level marketing talk—highlighting real strategies, real results, and real conversations that push the industry forward.

As **Founder & CEO of [New Era Intel](http://www.neweraintel.com)**, Bethany helps medical spas, dermatology clinics, and plastic surgery practices achieve smart, steady growth—not just flashy marketing. With over 15 years of experience in marketing and more than a decade inside aesthetic practices, she understands what truly moves the needle:  
not just branding or ads, but **streamlined systems, consistent patient journeys, and automation that actually works**.

Her journey began in 2009 at Advanced Dermatology, where she wore every hat—from front desk to billing to patient coordination and marketing. She saw the same frustrating pattern over and over: packed one month, empty the next. Even with a 22% increase in bookings, patients weren’t returning. That insight sparked a deep focus on operational efficiency, ultimately leading to breakthrough systems that:

- Reduced claim rejections by **35%**
- Increased qualified leads by **65%**
- Cut follow-up time by **60%**
- And slashed sales cycles by **40%** with CRM automation

That experience laid the foundation for her proprietary **Fully Booked CRM™**—a done-for-you platform that guarantees **15+ pre-qualified consults per month** through:

- AI-powered follow-up (even at 2AM)  
- Automated booking agents  
- Meta ad campaigns that actually convert  
- Funnel and website optimization that works in the real world

Unlike most agencies, Bethany’s consultancy isn’t about selling pre-packaged solutions. At New Era Intel, she dives into the operational underbelly of a practice, diagnoses what’s broken, and **builds custom strategies** to scale effectively—with a bold promise:

> “If we don’t deliver 15+ consults in 30 days, I work for free until we do.”

With over **15 podcast episodes recorded** and key industry leaders like Dr. Ashkan Ghavami, Shino Bay, and Melissa Haloossim on deck, *The Aesthetic Edge* is built to create mutual value—for guests, listeners, and aesthetic businesses alike.

create a guest primer for my podcast The Aesthetic Edge featuring: About Us

Peel Haus is the first and only aesthetic and plastic surgery center located on Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington, DC; the central hub for political power and decision-making in the United States. We offer premium medical-grade skincare services, chemical peels, wrinkle-relaxers, soft-tissue fillers, facial rejuvenation, and cosmetic plastic surgery.

The principal difference of Peel Haus Aesthetics and Plastic Surgery is that it provides its skincare professionals, nurse practitioners, and physicians a state-of-the-art space to practice their specialties and provides our patients with a variety of services and specialties. The concept was formed over light conservation between friends in the summer of 2021. Two entrepreneurial spirits who collectively have over 25 years of experience working in the medical aesthetic industry that dared to do something innovative. Sonya Lowery and Wendy Pittman have solved some of the industry’s most significant and challenging issues, creating a space that utilizes both aesthetics and medical services while curating a team of medical aesthetic professionals committed to high standards of treatment and service. In the spring of 2022 Sorelle Jones joined the team to make this a dynamic powerhouse of women entrepreneurs. Through this union they will provide excellence in the delivery of compassionate care to their patients and the neighboring community. The elite team of skincare professionals, nurse practitioners and physicians provide a wealth of knowledge in aesthetic services all without disrupting the natural integrity of one’s appearance. These 3 Washington, DC area natives have honed their skills and answered the call, vowing to bring energy and clear skin back to the faces of the community in which they live.

Our Mission
At Peel Haus Aesthetics & Plastic Surgery, we champion equity and inclusion in aesthetic medicine, as we believe that everyone deserves to look and feel their very best. We are committed to honest communication, excellence in practice, outstanding client experiences, and stunningly natural results. We want to help you become the greatest version of yourself and provide a safe, comfortable environment where trust and transparency are the foundation of our focus. The ability to celebrate and effectively treat everyone may not be the industry standard, but it is our standard.

Our Core Values
Excellence
Our team of providers comprises of 2 plastic surgeons – a nurse practitioner and a master medical esthetician, all of whom are rigorously trained in the latest techniques and treatment protocols of aesthetic care. Safety and results are our top priorities, and we will not offer any treatment we are not 100% confident we can perform to the highest degree.

Inclusion
We recognize the uniqueness in every individual we serve and create experiences that honor the beauty we see in each of our patients. We listen to, understand and work to meet each individual’s needs. We are poised to treat all skin tones and types and welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, identities, and abilities. We continue to learn about our evolving local and global communities and adapt as needed to maintain a safe aesthetic space for all.

Trust & Transparency
With trust at the cornerstone of every relationship at Peel Haus Aesthetics & Plastic Surgery, we focus on transparency and clear communication. Our patients can expect an honest approach conducted with integrity and a focus on their best interests. Our primary goal is to deliver outstanding experiences and results – each and every time.

Book An Appointment
CO-FOUNDERS

SORELLE COOPER, FNP-BC
President & CEO
Sorelle Cooper is a board-certified Nurse Practitioner with more than 19 years of experience in healthcare. She holds a B.A. and a B.S. with honors from the State University of New York at Buffalo and a Master of Science in Nursing degree from Johns Hopkins University. Her vast professional skill set has afforded her opportunities to care for patients both across the U.S. and internationally.

Formerly a primary care provider, Sorelle has spent years cultivating her knowledge and feeding her passion for all things medical aesthetics. She specializes in dozens of injection techniques to enhance and restore the features of the face and body. She has worked in dermatology, plastic surgery, and aesthetics practices in the DC/MD/VA Metro area and specializes in delivering spectacularly natural-looking results. She believes that finding pleasure in one’s own appearance can positively impact confidence, and thus, the greater life experience.

She enjoys educating others about aesthetics and had the honor to participate in and produce several panel discussions regarding this rapidly growing field. She also has the distinction of being a DermCare Team Member of the American Academy of Dermatology and an aesthetic consultant to Rabito Clinic, the largest provider of dermatology services in Ghana, West Africa.

WENDY PITTMAN
Vice President of Business Development
Wendy Pittman has been a transformative leader in medical aesthetics for over two decades, building a distinguished career at the intersection of innovation, business growth, and patient care excellence. With deep expertise in business development and a sharp eye for emerging markets, Wendy has played pivotal roles in bringing iconic treatments to market, including BOTOX® Cosmetic, Allergan® Medical’s Hylacross® and Vycross® soft tissue filler technologies, Latisse®, and Kybella®.

Her proven success in the industry propelled her into senior leadership roles, where she directed sales operations across multiple states at organizations such as Evolus, Vitality Institute, and Venus Concept. Wendy’s leadership consistently drove revenue growth, expanded brand presence, and cultivated teams known for understanding customer needs and delivering results.

As a former stakeholder at the Vitality Institute, Wendy was instrumental in shaping national business development initiatives, spearheading corporate strategy, and building influential partnerships with key opinion leaders. She also proudly founded The Brown Skin Agenda, a groundbreaking, physician-led initiative that advances treatment protocols and skincare solutions for skin of color, enhancing awareness and practitioner education nationwide.

Wendy is currently an executive board member of the Capitol Hill Business Improvement District (BID), where she leverages her business acumen and passion for community development to advocate for small businesses and drive initiatives that enrich Washington, DC’s vibrant Capitol Hill corridor.

She attributes her drive for excellence to collaborative relationships with industry leaders who share her vision for advancing evidence-based practices and innovative strategies that set new standards in patient care.

Wendy holds a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University of Maryland, College Park.



SONYA LOWERY-YOUNG, LE
Chief Brand Officer
Sonya Lowery-Young is a licensed Medical Aesthetician in Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia, with a clinical focus on skin-of-color and aging skin. Alongside her partners, Sonya helped develop many of the practice’s signature combination therapies—like GloTox—that pair injectables, chemical peels, and advanced skin treatments for results that are both natural-looking and transformative.
Sonya began her aesthetics career under the mentorship of one of the nation’s leading dermatologists, where she developed a deep foundation in clinical skincare and corrective treatments. Today, she’s known for her skill in treating hyperpigmentation, melasma, sun damage, acne, and age-related skin changes, with a special emphasis on restoring confidence in every client she sees. Her go-to modalities include HydraFacial, IPL, chemical peels, microneedling, laser hair removal, and ClearLift laser—combined with tailored skincare routines that support long-term skin health.
She is certified by both the Aveda Institute and The Esthetic Institute of Virginia and brings experience in beauty, wellness, and media to her practice. Sonya has been nationally recognized in Upscale Magazine, The Network Journal (as a 40 Under 40 honoree), and on the cover of Heart & Soul Magazine. In this episode, Bethany Gifford is joined by **Sorelle Cooper, FNP-BC**, **Wendy Pittman**, and **Sonya Lowery-Young, LE**, the dynamic co-founders of **Peel Haus Aesthetics & Plastic Surgery**—a first-of-its-kind medspa and plastic surgery center located on iconic Pennsylvania Avenue in Washington, D.C.

These powerhouse women are reshaping the landscape of inclusive, results-driven aesthetic care with deep industry roots, strategic innovation, and a shared commitment to clinical excellence. Their story is one of vision, grit, and transformative leadership—and this episode explores it all.

### 🧭 Call Structure & Interview Topics

#### 🔹 1. Call Intro (1 minute)
Bethany will open the conversation with:
> “Great to meet you. Before we dive in, here’s how the call will go:  
> • We’ll start with your background and the industry trends you’re seeing.  
> • Then, we’ll discuss your current challenges and where you want to be in the next 6–12 months.  
> • Finally, we’ll wrap up by exploring any next steps if it makes sense.  
>  
> The whole conversation will take about 30–40 minutes. Does that sound good?”

---

#### 🔹 2. Main Questions (30 minutes)

##### **About Your Role & Business**
- “Can you share a bit about your role and how it fits into the bigger picture at Peel Haus?”
- “What does a typical day look like for each of you?”

##### **Industry Trends**
- “What major shifts are you seeing in the aesthetics/med spa industry right now?”
- “How has increased competition or rising patient expectations impacted your growth strategy?”

##### **Current State**
- “What’s working well for you right now, and what’s been frustrating?”
- “Which metrics are you most focused on improving — retention, patient lifetime value, treatment conversions?”

##### **Future Goals**
- “Where do you want to be six or twelve months from now?”
- “If you could solve one major challenge today, what would it be?”

**Probing Follow-ups**  
- “That’s interesting — can you expand on that?”  
- “Do you think this is an industry-wide issue or more unique to your practice?”

---

#### 🔹 3. Transition & Wrap-Up (5 minutes)

Bethany will thank you and close the interview with:  
> “That was great — thank you for sharing these insights. Please let our audience know how they can contact you!  
> Once we’ve compiled all our podcast conversations, I’ll send over a summary that should be really interesting.”
